pages.text: Fill a tank with a fuel such as lava, then drop ore or ingots into the smeltery's melting slots. The controller's interface shows the current temperature; once the structure is hot enough, the items melt into molten metal.
Attach a faucet to a drain and place a casting table beneath it. Right-click the faucet to pour the molten metal onto the table and cast it into a part or an ingot.
